contents.name: Two-group risk-set score and conditional hypergeometric moments

contents.name: Weighted score construction
contents.reason: The local definition fixes pre-event weights and separates the plug-in variance and normal calibration from the Fisher randomization p-value.

sources.title: Lu Tian, STAT331 Unit 13: Large Sample Theory for 2-Sample Tests
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–12 of the 14-page Unit 13 PDF: two-sample right-censoring setup, risk-set fractions, common-hazard score expansion, weight conditions, and terminal asymptotics.

contents.name: Uniform empirical risk-set proportions and limiting treatment fraction
contents.reason: Used as an independent risk-set limit treatment; the page locally verifies pointwise measurability, envelope, and finite bracketing entropy.

contents.name: Weighted score martingale decomposition under equal hazards
contents.reason: The source supplies the classical route and conditions; the authored proof derives the exact terminal expansion using the explicit supplier contracts and isometry.

contents.name: Variance estimate and terminal equal-hazard limit
contents.reason: The local proof establishes plug-in consistency from risk-fraction convergence and the compensator decomposition, without importing a process CLT.

contents.name: Process-level martingale asymptotics
contents.reason: The controlling design excludes a process CLT; only the fixed terminal statistic is proved here.

sources.locator: Complete 99-page notes; §5.3–5.4, PDF pp. 59–62 / printed pp. 595–625: two-sample logrank and weighted scores, risk-set martingales, moment calculations, and asymptotic discussion.

contents.name: Weighted logrank risk-set score and conditional variance
contents.reason: Independent full-notes treatment used to check the score and variance conventions; the page states its tie, boundary, and null distinctions explicitly.

contents.name: Weighted score martingale representation and moment route
contents.reason: The local proof checks every model-contract premise and proves its own risk-fraction and weight replacements; no functional limit theorem is imported.

contents.name: Asymptotic weighted logrank variance
contents.reason: The source is an independent check of the target variance expression; the finite-dimensional Gaussian conclusion is proved through the separately inspected group-influence supplier.

contents.name: Process limit theorem stated in the notes
contents.reason: A terminal result is in scope; a process CLT and confidence band are expressly excluded.

sources.title: Siva Balakrishnan, CMU 36-705 Lecture 28: Fisher's Exact p-values

contents.name: Sharp-null imputability and an exact logrank ordering
contents.reason: The source is used for the sharp-null randomization setup; the local proof uses the batch-12 theorem for arbitrary actual assignment weights and proves record encoding and score measurability.

contents.name: Equal-probability permutation implementation discussed in the lecture
contents.reason: This example uses unequal assignment probabilities; the proof relies on the weighted finite-rank theorem, not an equal-probability permutation shortcut.
